name: Case law: Poland, the Trybunał Konstytucyjny (Constitutional Tribunal)
label: Poland case law (the Trybunał Konstytucyjny (Constitutional Tribunal))
coverage: 9503 judgments with text from SAOS, one file and one commit each, dated the day given; 62422 citations of law linked to poland-law.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day given. Judgments with no usable date are in decisions/undated/. SAOS holds no judgment of the Trybunał Konstytucyjny (Constitutional Tribunal) given after 2015-12-09: later judgments are not in this record, though it was checked against SAOS on 2026-11-07.

source.publisher: SAOS, System Analizy Orzeczeń Sądowych (saos.org.pl), from the courts' own portals
